lines.text: Τῷ δὲ γʹ δεκανῷ παρανατέλλει ἀνὴρ νέος ἐπὶ δίφρου καθεζόμενος,
lines.en: And alongside the 3rd decan there rises a young man sitting on a stool,

lines.en: holding 2 zodiac signs by a horn, and behind the stool a man bent

lines.en: remaining half of the snake.

lines.text: Κατὰ δὲ Ἰνδοὺς παρανατέλλει τῷ τοιούτῳ δεκανῷ ἀνὴρ λευκός,

lines.text: ἔχων τρίχας ἀληθινὰς καὶ θυμώδης, φορῶν βραχιόλιον ξύλινον καὶ
lines.en: having true hair and spirited, wearing a wooden bracelet and

lines.en: ble; and he wishes to do good, because such a

lines.en: And according to Ptolemy there rises alongside this decan the chest

lines.en: And according to the Indians there rises alongside this decan a multiform woman

lines.text: ὡραία καὶ σγουρά, ἔχουσα τέκνα καὶ φοροῦσα ἱμάτια, ὧν μέρος τι
lines.en: beautiful and curly-haired, having children and wearing garments, of which a part

lines.en: for her children.

lines.en: And according to Ptolemy there rises alongside this decan the parts of

lines.en: and the tail of the Ram and the jaws of the sea-monster.

sections.text: 4 Περσέω cod. 6 λίνιον cod. 8 διὰ κέρατος in codd. Arabicis non habetur sed ex Κασσιέπεια ortum esse videtur. Ceterum cum his duobus ζῳδίοις s. " imaginibus " (sic Arab.), cf. ἄγαλμα γυμνόν, quod cynocephalus tenet (Sphaera, p. 218). 13 ἀληθινός cod.; ἀληθινός = purpureus. 15 κοσμοδρομικὴν non intellego : κοσμοποιητικὴν (sc. artem mundum muliebrem conficiendi)? " Fabricae ferreae peritus " Arab. 21 πλεξοίδιον, ni fallor, codex : " Stirnhaar ... (des Widders) " vertit Dyroff ex Arab. Πλεξίδα s. πλεξίδιον = πλόκαμος. 22 γίγας i. e. Orion. 26 post νεκρᾶς spatium fere 20 litterarum : supplevi ex Arab. 27 κεφαλήν cod. 29 σγουρά non " obscura " (sic Du Cange), sed " crispa " (Dyroff); hodie quoque verbum hoc sensu usurpatur.
sections.en: 4 Περσέω cod. 6 λίνιον cod. 8 διὰ κέρατος is not found in the Arabic codices but seems to have arisen from Κασσιέπεια. Otherwise with these two zodiac signs or "images" (thus the Arab.), cf. the naked statue, which the cynocephalus holds (Sphaera, p. 218). 13 ἀληθινός cod.; ἀληθινός = purple. 15 κοσμοδρομικὴν I do not understand: κοσμοποιητικὴν (sc. the art of making feminine adornment)? "Skilled in iron fabrication" Arab. 21 πλεξοίδιον, unless I am mistaken, the codex: "Forelock ... (of the Ram)" translates Dyroff from the Arab. Πλεξίδα or πλεξίδιον = lock of hair. 22 γίγας i. e. Orion. 26 after νεκρᾶς a space of about 20 letters: I supplied from the Arab. 27 κεφαλήν cod. 29 σγουρά not "obscure" (thus Du Cange), but "curly" (Dyroff); today also this word is used in this sense.

summary.headline: Ptolemaic and Indian Decan Figures
summary.text: Decan descriptions for the 3rd decan and the 1st decan of Taurus, comparing Ptolemy’s rising figures with Indian images: Perseus, zodiacal and animal figures, a giant identified as Orion, a ship, and human figures associated with Zeus, Ares, and the Ram.
